premise: Generations ago the sun stopped on the horizon. Lamplighters walk the old roads to wake the beacons that once called the morning.

scene.name: Vesper Cliffs
scene.summary: A basalt cliff road above a sea of cloud. It crosses a rope bridge, passes the keeper's bench and ends at the cold Vesper beacon, with far towers on the spires beyond.

character.name: Ilo

abilities.name: Kindle
abilities.description: Wake a cold beacon with the flame you carry.

abilities.name: Carried flame
abilities.description: The light you carry pushes the dusk back around you.

rules: Ilo carries a light that can be seen in the dusk.
Ilo walks the road and does not fly or teleport.

script.keeperGreeting: Another lamplighter on the cliff road. The last one turned back at the bridge.
script.keeperRequest: The beacon has been cold three winters. The far towers will not wake until Vesper does.
script.keeperAfter: Look along the cliffs. The far towers are answering.
